description.en:
L.A.G, an unknown space where humans use abilities or skills through awakening, monsters appear on each floor and room, and missions are given accordingly.

The goal here is to reach the bottom. The protagonist repeats death and life countless times in the unknown space L.A.G. However, in this life, he has the ability to own unlimited passive skills and finally has a chance to escape there.

However, unlike what he has been through so far, he will not know an inch of the future as L.A.G continues to change. This is a desperate survival story in which no one can be trusted and continues to survive the hellish L.A.G, where there is no end in sight, and fights for escape from the bottom.
description.ko:
인간이 각성을 통해 능력이나 스킬을 쓸고 있고
각 층, 방마다 몬스터들이 나오고
거기에 따른 미션이 주어지는 미지의 공간 L.A.G

이곳의 목표는 최하층에 도달하는 것이다.
그 알 수 없는 공간 L.A.G에서
수없이 죽음과 삶을 반복하고 있는 주인공.
하지만 이번 생에는 패시브 스킬을
무한으로 소유할 수 있는 능력을 갖게 되고
드디어 이곳을 탈출할 수 있는 기회가 찾아온다.

그러나 L.A.G도 지금까지 자신의 겪어왔던 것과 달리
계속 변하게 되면서 한 치 앞도 알 수 없게 된다.
그 누구도 믿을 수 없고
끝이 보이지 않는 지옥 같은 L.A.G에서
끝까지 살아남아 최하층 탈출을 위해 싸워나가는
처절한 생존 서바이벌.
description.ru: Что будет, если дать расчётливому человеку возможность бесконечно наращивать количество пассивных навыков и поставить перед ним целью выбраться из заточения, в которое он попал против своей воли? L.A.G - мистическое сооружение с огромным количеством помещений и этажей, что бесконечно тянутся вниз. Здесь люди вынуждены сражаться за свою жизнь в попытках попасть на самый нижний этаж, в котором, предположительно, они найдут все ответы. В придачу ко всему, L.A.G играет роль системы, благодаря которой игроки получают навыки и постоянно наращивают боевой потенциал. Здесь не выживает сильнейший - сильнейшим становится тот, кто выжил.
description.pt-br:
L.A.G, um local desconhecido onde humanos através de um despertar conseguem utilizar perícias e habilidades especiais e precisam concluir missões derrotando os monstros que aparecem em cada sala de cada andar.
O objetivo é alcançar o último andar do subterrâneo. O protagonista repete o ciclo de vida e morte incontáveis vezes no espaço desconhecido de L.A.G.
No entanto, desta vez, foi lhe concedido a aptidão de possuir habilidades passivas ilimitadas, e, com isso, ele usará dessa oportunidade peculiar para escapar desse inferno.

description.en:
I'm going to live a normal life!

...said Shari Azriel, the apothecary of the Dover village.

Then one day, I realised that I possessed an NPC in a video game! I've been locked up here for two years, and I only just noticed.

If I can't get out of the game...
"A, in their 20's, was found starved to death while playing VR games."
This could be what I'm remembered as!

"I have to get out!"

However, it was too late when I came to the realisation that... I can't log out because of an error!

That means, the only way out would be approaching the male lead, "the Lord of Nightmares," and helping his comrades defeat the final villain. So I have no choice but to wait until the game ends...

The difficulty level, the story, the likelihood of failure in such a heinous game, a game that nobody won before...

"The Lord of Nightmares has a strong urge to kill you."

Somehow, I believe that dying by the male lead's hands would be faster.

"You’re its prey the moment you touch it." 

One day, a terrible virus variant attacks Seoul! 

Yeon-woo is on a school trip to Seoul, and is excited thinking that he can finally get along with his one classmate, So-yeon, whom he has a crush on.

However, during this time, unidentified cells appeared in front of Yeon-woo’s class, who were sightseeing in Seoul. The mutant cells manifestation quickly turns Yeon-woo and his classmates’ school trip into hell as anyone who comes into contact with the cells will become a hideous monster that wants to consume anything with flesh...! 

Will Yeon-woo be able to leave Seoul safely?

And she knows how this ends… it's off with her head! Maybe she'll just let this play out and wake up back in reality… But after a few too many deaths to no avail, it's finally time to go off-script. Condamnée à mourir le jour de ses 20 ans puis à ressusciter encore et toujours pour l'éternité, c'est là, sa malédiction. Mais quitte à voir son avenir ruiné, autant vivre comme on le souhaite! La méchante est bien décidée à suivre cet adage et a changé l'histoire du roman où elle se trouve. L'héroïne, sa rivale? Plus question! Elle est tellement adorable, plutôt en faire sa meilleure amie! Le fiancé? Un prince héritier cruel et idiot, mieux vaut l'éliminer du paysage. Cependant, à chacune de ses décisions s'éloignant de l'histoire originale, le futur se modifie. As Seolhwi lies dying, lamenting years of service to the cult with nothing to show for it, he is suddenly faced with a video game prompt, asking if he would like to start again. Noelle Miceria is the bastard daughter of a noble family and suffers abuse by everyone in the house.  
  
One day, Noelle overhears her father's terrible plan. That night she asked the help of her friend Zion who came to visit the family.  
  
When she came to my senses, the people who bullied her had been killed. The culprit was Zion, turns out that he knew how to wield magic.  
  
"What do you think, Noelle?"  
  
Zion offers Noelle a life-changing offer to work for him. From that day on, Noelle started to live in Zion's mansion and work as his assistant  
  
Dear friend, Duke, and wizard, these are all Zion titles but does Noelle really knows Zion?  
  
The original romance fantasy you've never seen before!

description.en:
On the night the kingdom fell and the entire royal family was being executed, Clarisse, who naturally thought she would also die, heard something unexpected. 

“We cannot execute anyone who has not reached the age of eighteen. Instead, I will kill you the day you turn eighteen.” 

And so, Clarisse is given ten years to live. 
Clarisse then heads North as a “prisoner.” 
And she asks the Grand Duke for only one thing… 

“Um, is it okay if I take this friend with me? It’s my only friend.” 

But what Clarisse holds out is a rock? 

It’s a new life in the North! 
But this life as a “prisoner” keeps on getting better…?
description.tr:
Krallığın düştüğü gece ve bütün kraliyet ailesinin idam edildiği sırada, doğal olarak öleceğini düşünen Clarisse, beklenmedik bir şey duydu.
“18 yaşına ulaşmamış olan kimseyi idam edemeyiz. Bunun yerine, 18 yaşına bastığın gün seni öldüreceğim.”
Ve böylece, Clarisse’e yaşaması için on yıl süre verilir.
Clarisse sonra bir “esir” olarak Kuzey’e doğru yol alır.
Ve Büyük Dük’ten sadece bir şey ister…
“Uhm, bu arkadaşımı yanımda götürebilir miyim? O benim tek dostum.”
Ancak Clarisse’nin uzattığı şey bir taş mı? Kuzey’de yeni bir hayat!
Ancak bu “esir” hayatı daha da iyiye gidiyor gibi mi?

description.en:
"We should get a divorce."  
  
A marriage without love.  
Choi Mo-won was a man who thought marriage was solely for business.  
  
But Lee Yu-rae, the woman he was married to, suddenly asked him for a divorce.  
  
Three years later, one day, in an unexpected place, they reunited in a strange relationship….  
  
"Do you want to go out with me?"  
  
His wife is back.  
  
But is she the same woman he used to know?  
  
His once lifeless heart started to beat.  
And that too, for his ex-wife, who has returned.

description.en:
Kate Smith enjoys her quiet life as a maid and has no interest in getting married. Her resolve only deepens as she watches her peers swoon over the moody manservant, Ian. Whether it's fate or bad luck, Kate quickly finds herself in a series of compromising encounters with him. One day another maid goes missing and the mystical happenings that follow only intensify her suspicions about Ian. As the expert detective Jade Killian comes into town, can he help her uncover the truth?

---
Kate is a maid at the Baron's estate in Muiella, a country where warlocks and witches are shunned. One day, the new servant Ian arrives… but he's much too proper and handsome for his lowly rank. As they keep running into each other, Kate's suspicion of Ian's disarming demeanor only grows when strange incidents crop up in the manor. Sleuthing for the truth, the wellbeing of the estate and its residents may be at stake! Where's a good detective when you need one?!

Simple deomestique dans un manoir à la campagne, elle ne pensait pas se retrouver mêlée à un mystère. La disparition d’une de ses amies va la pousser à enquêter sur les mystères entourant le manoir...

---
Kate est une domestique dans un manoir à Muiella, une contrée où les gens dotés de pouvoirs magiques sont rejetés. Un jour, Ian, un nouveau domestique arrive… Mais il est bien trop impeccable et élégant pour un simple servant.

Les soupçons de Kate quant au comportement désarmant de Ian ne font que grandir à mesure que d’étranges incidents se produisent dans le manoir.

La recherche de la vérité pourrait bien mettre tous les résidents en danger! Où trouver un bon détective quand on en a besoin?!

description.en: Sometimes it is not necessarily a pie that falls from the sky, it may also be a "dream". The protagonist, who was reaching the lowest point of his life, fortuitously receives an Artificial Intelligence robot that claims to assist people in realising their dreams. Can the protagonist change his fate successfully?

The world is being assimilated by a crazy religion, and to stop it I have become their satan. The religion is controlled by aliens, and people don’t have a clue. The world says that aliens don’t exist, but they are everywhere. How am so I certain? Because I am also an alien.

Although she is just a college freshman, Kim Danjo, much like her name, lives a monotonous life. One day Danjo goes to a storage room to run an errand for her sunbae when she witnesses a broom transform into a human girl. From that day on, the broom persistently asks for Danjo's help, claiming she has no where to go. In the end, Danjo accidentally gives the broom who claims to actually be a Dookkabei (Korean supernatural creature) the name Eundohae and they start living together in Danjo's small gosiwon.

description.en:
Selene, the daughter who dreams of becoming a hero, and Shion, the demon king who adopted her. Shion has to conceal his true identity at all costs, unable to cheer on his daughter’s dreams or attempt to stop her.
This is the story of Selene’s journey to becoming a true hero amidst this dilemma… Or is it the parenting story of the demon king?!

Shin Youngwoo is a pure loser in life who is also heavily indebted to an insurance company.   
He lives with his dissappointed parents and brilliant younger sister who is one top students at her school. Even in games, like the popular VRMMORPG game Satisfy he's a total loser.  
  
But one day, while on a quest he miraculously finds a Legendary Book that can give anyone who reads it the never before seen Legendary Class!  
  
He was planning to sell it for alot of money but luck was always his worst trait.  
Through an unlucky change of the situation his dream was short-lived as he was forced to use the item for himself.  
  
His life changed forever since that fateful day…

description.en:
This is a world whose peace was destroyed by the Shadow Lord, ‘Secneum’. ‘Niro’ is a half-elf, half-human boy who lost his parents as a baby and was adopted by a slave couple. In this world, slaves are not treated as humans. Since Niro’s adoptive parents are slaves, they are mistreated and eventually lose their lives. Now Niro is alone once more, and must shoulder the burdens of his family and do whatever is takes to protect his two younger siblings. If Niro wants to escape this fate, there is only one thing he can do. He must graduate from the academy, ‘Excanum’ just like the current Emperor, ‘Muren’ who was once a slave!

description.pt-br: Em um mundo em que a paz foi destruída pelo Governante das Sombras, ‘Secneum’. ‘Niro’, um meio-elfo e meio-humano que perdeu seus pais quando ainda era um bebê, foi adotado por um casal de escravos. Nesse mundo, escravos não são considerados humanos. Como os pais adotivos de Niro são escravos, eles sofrem maus tratos constantemente até perderem suas vidas. Agora, Niro está sozinho novamente e deve suportar o peso de sua família e fazer o que for necessário para proteger seus irmãos caçulas. Se Niro quiser fugir do mesmo destino que seus pais, só há uma saída, se graduar na academia ‘Excanum’, igual ao imperador atual, ‘Muren’ que um dia também foi um escravo!

只不過，身為奴隸的尼洛似乎找不到
進入「艾斯卡儂」就讀的辦法...

他究竟能不能擺脫絕望，成功進到「艾斯卡儂」呢?

description.en: After waking up as the cruel mother in one of her favorite dark fantasy books, Seriel Roperam makes it her mission to steer her adorable son, Kardiciel, away from his future as the story's twisted male lead. However, her prior cold actions have left Kardiciel and her husband, Erykian, wary of her. After an initial awkward phase where neither of them believed her, the three of them slowly learn to rely on and trust one another. Will this once-dysfunctional family finally find their happy ending, or have Seriel's past actions left wounds too deep to heal?
description.fr: Je suis devenue la mère du méchant de l'histoire que je lisais avant de mourir? En voyant le personnage «méchant» qui n'est pour l'instant qu'un enfant innocent, j'ai décidé de l'élever «correctement» pour éviter une fin tragique pour nous tous. Cependant, cet objectif ne semble pas aussi facile à atteindre...

description.en:
The princess of the Roachim Empire was killed by her older brother.
Killed, accused of killing their father, the Emperor, she…
 
Kyuaang?
 
…was reincarnated as a divine beast?!
 
An unexpected second life.
But something seems weird?
 
The ruler of the north of the Roachim Empire.
The owner of the Idelbadour Mountains and the Ice Wall.
The Grand Duke of Elharan, whom the Emperor himself cannot approach recklessly…
 
‘My dad, so you mean I’m a divine beast?!’
 
***
 
“My lady…!”
“Please accept these tributes and send down your blessings!”
 
The villagers knelt together at once and prayed earnestly.
While wiggling and not knowing what to do, I heard the sound of laughter in my ear.
 
-Lusha got stronger!
-She’s strong! She’s fresh! She’s thrilling!
-Look at that, even the humans surrendered in the face of Lusha!

The spirits were terribly proud of her, saying that the humans were afraid because of Lusha’s power.
And they lifted her in the air and carried her.
Encompassing her was also a dazzling light that appeared out of nowhere.
Everyone who was praying opened their eyes wide.
 
“It’s the blessing of the Divine Beast!”
“Hooray for the Baby Fox!”
 
Lusha sighed.
 
“Kiiyuu…”

description.en:
The symbol of beauty and money, Tatiana Cartien, the most eligible bachelorette of the Freya Empire. The despair of being betrayed by her trusted fiancé lasted only a moment, as who could've known a bigger shock would happen.

"I'll only endure for a few days, getting discovered in an idiotic manners of all ways."

To think that her family, who she believed was on her side, knew her fiancé's nature. Tatiana threatened to never get married, and her mother, who once coddled her, abandoned her.

"If you say you don't want to then I guess you should leave this house."

"..."

"Of course, you should leave behind everything I've given to you."

The time she has left is one week. If she can't find someone worth marrying, she'll be kicked out onto the streets with nothing.

Just when she thought, "Is this the end?" one person came to mind! Kainel Towncent, an illegitimate child who had once been treated with contempt, who then rose from mercenary to the hailed war hero of Freya in 3 years.

A road with a dead end, there's nothing left to lose. In order to survive in this grim world, grabbing the hand of the devil is enough.

"Tatiana Cartien. No matter what anyone says from now on, you're the lady of Towncent. If you come to me with an offer of marriage first, then you need to take responsibility until the end."

---
As the beloved daughter of a viscountess and the fiancée of a duke, Tatiana Cartienne was the belle of high society. But when she refuses to marry after discovering the duke's infidelity, she begins to see that she was simply a pawn in her family's power play. In her attempt to break free, she turns to Kynell Townsend, a war hero who was once humiliated by the viscountess for his attempt to woo Tatiana. With title and fortune out of the picture, will they be able to reset their love story?
description.fr: Fille adorée d'une vicomtesse et fiancée d'un duc, Tatiana Cartien était la fleur de la haute société. Mais lorsqu'elle refuse de se marier après avoir découvert l'infidélité du duc, elle commence à comprendre qu'elle n'était qu'un pion dans l’échiquier du pouvoir de sa famille. Pour tenter de se libérer de cette dernière, elle se tourne vers Kainel Towncent, un héros de guerre qui a été humilié quelques années plutôt par la vicomtesse pour avoir tenté de séduire Tatiana. Sans titre ni fortune, parviendront-ils à relancer leur histoire d'amour ?
description.ru: Татьяне Картье осталась неделя чтобы найти мужа, после того, как он предал её. Последним, о ком она думала, был наёмник Кайнел Таунсенд. Она решает более никому не доверять, и заключить с ним брак по контракту, но... Почему её сердце так быстро бьётся?
description.uk:
Символ краси і грошей, Татьяна Картьє - найшанованіша наречена в імперії Фрея. 
ЇЇ розпач від зради власного нареченого тривав лише одну мить, адже хто б знав, що далі справи підуть тільки гірше.

"Міг почекати декілька днів, а не попастися як ідіот." 

Я вірила, що моя родина на моїй стороні, але вони знали про зраду мого нареченого. Через свої погрози, що вона ніколи не вийде заміж, мати Татьяни, яка так сильно любила її, відвернулася від неї. 
Якщо тобі щось не подобається, то можеш забиратися геть.
“... “
І звісно ж, ти повинна залишити все, що я тобі дала.
У неї залишився всього лиш тиждень. Якщо вона за цей час вона не знайде собі чоловіка, її виженуть на вулицю ні з чим.

І в мить, коли вона подумала:”Це кінець”, на думку спала одна людина!
Кайнель Таунсент, позашлюбна дитина до якої ставилися з презирством, який за три роки прославився, як герой війни Фреї.

Загнана в глухий кут, де немає нічого втрачати. Для виживання в цьому світі, потрібно схопити диявола за руку

“Татьяна Картьє, щоб хто не казав, але віднині ви леді Таунсест.
Якщо ти перша запропонувала мені одружитися, то будь готова взяти на себе відповідальність до самого кінця.”

description.en:
When there is no way out, the way is in.

Doomed to die next month, our terminally ill protagonist Chan is too frail and defeated to try anything at all.

No wonder he chooses to plunge himself into an RPG world he is only too familiar with. Why should this run be any different?

Well, other than the fact that he will wake up inside the game and get struck with an existential epiphany that will make him fight tooth and nail to give Nox, his equally ill-fated RPG persona, a better chance?

Maybe, it’s not over until it’s over.

A fantasy romance transcending time and space! Jacheongbi, a student of Taekwondo, stumbles into the world of an ash-scented palace!  
  
After a spectacular win in the national Taekwondo trials, Jacheongbi meets a man from her dreams in the hospital garden. After choosing to follow him, Jacheongbi is led into a lake by the hand and opened her eyes to find herself in a glorious palace! Stuck in a strange country with no friends, how will she be able to return home?  
  
After hearing a tale of death in the river only to return to life with her help, Jacheongbi realizes her way home is through the river! Rather than returning outside where it’s full of danger, she remains in the place where she awoke. A situation in-which her mind couldn’t be made up…   
  
A handsome crown prince, her savior the Prince of Misfortune, and the playful, tomboy princess who claimed ownership of Jacheongbi— She begins preparing for a quick, safe return home…

description.id: Atas perintah tuannya, seorang pelayan bernama Edna dipaksa menyamar dan menikah dengan Duke Eli, bangsawan baru yang dulunya hanyalah rakyat biasa. Akibat putri tuannya yang tidak mau menikah dengan Eli, Edna menerima peran tersebut tanpa bisa menolak. Tanpa ada yang mengetahui, Edna menyimpan rahasia besar tentang siapa dirinya sebenarnya. Dia menutupi asal-usulnya yang merupakan keturunan Raja dari kerajaan yang dihancurkan oleh suaminya sendiri, Eli. Di tengah kehidupan rumah tangga yang dibangun atas kebohongan, Edna diam-diam menaruh tekad untuk memperbaiki wilayah kekuasaannya yang hancur.
description.ja:
私は生き残る。何があっても… 身代わりで嫁いだ召使いの出生の秘密とは?

ウィリアム子爵邸宅の召使い「エドナ」は、子爵の娘「アナ」の身代わりに戦争で英雄となった平民出身の貴族「イーライ」と突如結婚させられることに。 
身代わりだとわかれば殺される…そんな恐怖を抱きつつイーライのもとに向かったエドナだったが、早々に嘘がバレてしまう事態に!
”私はできれば生き残りたい”そう言って『妻』だけでなく『夜の慰みもの』になるというイーライとの取引を受け入れるエドナ。 
どこか堂々とした彼女の姿に、イーライは興味を持ち始めるのだった。しかし、そんなエドナには誰にも言えない秘密があって――。
description.ko: 주인의 명령에 신분을 속이고 피의 전사 '일라이'와 결혼하게 된 하녀 '에드나‘. 결혼 후 자신이 하녀라는 사실이 금방 들통나지만 ‘일라이’는 크게 문제 삼지 않는다. 그러나 ‘일라이’가 미처 모르고 있던 진실이 숨겨져 있는데… 바로 ‘에드나’가 자신이 몰락시킨 왕가의 후계자였다는 것... 이는 ‘에드나’가 왕자로 18년간 자신의 정체성을 숨기고 살아왔기 때문이다! 그런 ‘에드나’도 전쟁에 미친놈이라고 소문이 자자한 ‘일라이’의 숨겨진 매력에 점점 빠져들게 되고, 결국 ‘일라이’의 영지를 풍요롭게 가꾸기 위해 18년간 받아온 왕가의 교육을 토대로 당당하고 카리스마 있는 영주의 아내로 거듭나는데…
description.th: 'เอ็ดน่า' สาวใช้ในคฤหาสน์ของท่านไวส์เคาต์วิลเลี่ยมจำยอมต้องแต่งงานกับ 'อิลไล' ดยุกหนุ่มอนาคตไกลผู้มาจากครอบครัวชนชั้นกลางแทนลูกสาวของท่านไวส์เคาต์ และแน่นอนว่าความลับไม่มีในโลก เมื่ออิลไลจับได้และรู้ความจริงเข้าก็โกรธมาก แต่ในขณะเดียวกันเขาก็เริ่มสนใจในตัวเอ็ดน่าด้วย จากสาวใช้ก้นครัวสู่การเป็นภรรยาของท่านดยุก ความลับที่บอกใครไม่ได้ของเอ็ดน่า...
description.uk: Це груба образа королівської влади, коли скромну і свавільну служницю Едну відправляють одружитися з герцогом Елі замість благородної дочки, яку він очікував. Але амбітна дівчина приховує за цією очевидною хитрістю ще більшу таємницю, яка може змінити історію королівства. Чи зможуть ці двоє знайти свободу, спокуту — і кохання — не оголюючи один проти одного мечі? За мотивами новели.
description.zh: 在海上之国的残忍生存法则下长大的公主，为了成为王而踏上历练之路的年轻王储。一场别有用心的出逃，一次伴随着惊险与刺激的浪漫相遇。航海从来都是勇敢者的游戏，王储&公主：“我会是最后的赢家！”
description.pt-br:
Foi um verdadeiro insulto quando a humilde e teimosa serva Edna veio a se casar com o duque Eli no lugar da nobre filha que ele esperava.

Mas a ambiciosa serva esconde um segredo por trás de seu óbvio estratagema - um que poderia mudar toda a história do reino, os dois irão conseguir encontrar a liberdade, a redenção - e amor - sem usarem suas espadas um no outro?

description.en:
"Pretend to be my lover and join the social circle."

Selena, the top star that had the entire world's attention, was suddenly warped to Northern Duke's land during an accident while filming. Kalcion, the Northern Duke that saved her from the infernal beasts, offers Selena a chance to go back home in return for collecting information in various social circles by pretending to be his lover. Selena quickly accepts Kalcion's offer, but… 

"Why in the world can't you do this!?"

 "Don't you think that the answer to that should be obvious to you, the actress, not to me, the duke?"

There was a critical problem. The Northern Duke's acting skills are horrible!

"…Let's change the plan. I'll seduce you instead."

And thus the contractual relationship between the two started. Will Kalcion's acting skill improve first, or will he start to have true feelings for Selena instead?

---

When she regains consciousness, she realizes she has traveled to the Kingdom of Iklein and meets the northern duke Calcion, who saves her from a demonic beast. Calcion asks her to be his fake lover so she can get into socialite and discover the conspiracy happening in his castle.

description.fr:
«Prétendre être mon amant et rejoindre le cercle social.»

Selena, la top star qui avait l'attention du monde entier, a soudainement atterrit dans le pays du Duc du Nord lors d'un accident de tournage. Kalcion, le duc du Nord qui l'a sauvée des bêtes infernales, offre à Selena une chance de rentrer chez elle en échange de la collecte d'informations dans divers cercles sociaux en prétendant être son amant. Selena accepte rapidement l'offre de Kalcion, mais...

«Pourquoi diable ne pouvez-vous pas pas faire ça?»

«Ne pensez-vous pas que la réponse à cette question devrait être évidente pour vous, l'actrice, et non pour moi, le duc?»

Il y avait un problème crucial. Les compétences d'acteur du Duc du Nord étaient horribles!

«...Changeons de plan. Je vais vous séduire à la place.»

Et c'est ainsi que la relation contractuelle entre les deux commença. Le talent d'acteur de Kalcion va-t-il s'améliorer en premier, ou va-t-il commencer à éprouver de vrais sentiments pour Selena?

---
Selena, une super star sous les feux de la rampe, se retrouve par accident sur les terres du Duc du Nord alors qu'elle était en plein tournage. Kalcion, le duc, la sauve des bêtes sauvages qui la menacent et lui offre une chance de retourner dans son monde. En échange, elle doit se faire passer pour sa petite amie et glaner des informations sur les réseaux sociaux. Selena accepte la proposition du duc, mais le Duc du Nord est un très mauvais acteur. Selena se met donc en tête de le séduire pour que la réalité rattrappe la fiction et que leur relation paraisse vraisemblable.

“Finja ser minha amante e participe dos círculos sociais.”

Selena, uma estrela que atraiu a atenção do mundo todo, repentinamente foi parar nas terras do Duque do Norte após um acidente durante as filmagens. 

Kalcion, o Duque do Norte, que a salvou de bestas infernais, oferece a ela chance de voltar para casa em troca de coletar informações em vários círculos sociais, fingindo ser sua amante. 

Selena aceitou rapidamente a oferta de Kalcion, mas…

“Por que diabos você não consegue fazer isso?!”

“Não acha que a resposta deveria ser óbvia para você a atriz, e não para mim, o duque?”

Surgiu um problema crítico. 

As habilidades de atuação do duque são terríveis!

“… Vamos mudar o plano. Em vez disso, vou seduzi-lo.”

E assim, a relação contratual entre os dois começou.

A habilidade de atuação de Kalcion irá melhorar primeiro, ou ele começará a ter sentimentos verdadeiros por Selena?

description.en: Regret is the bane of old men. When aging Alliance Lord Hajin Cheon of the Grand Martial Alliance reflects on his immense legacy, he finds that he recalls little of his deeds or even the lives of his closest advisors. Stricken by a mysterious ailment, Hajin suddenly passes away only to wake up in the body of Ridan Byeok, heir to the Byeok Clan of swordsmen. The only problem is, Ridan is a well-known wastrel, the polar opposite of the virtuous and stern Hajin. Righting the wrongs of his predecessor, Hajin begins to uncover the truth behind his death…

description.en:
The Primordial Core’s an unconquerable dungeon, the lair of the most powerful monster ever to exist, the Original Monster, the incarnation of evil — Swallow... who happens to be a lazy boss monster who just wants to sleep.

Taking care of this lazy bum is Renee, a homunculus maid whose obsession with Swallow knows no bounds. At this point, the only one keeping the dungeon running is Patrick, the last brain cell of the bunch — and he’s a skeleton!

Will Mr. Swallow get any rest amid all this chaos?
description.ru:
В глубинах древнего подземелья, известного как «Ядро Древности», обитает легендарное существо — древний монстр Сваллоу. Веками его имя внушало ужас и трепет, считаясь воплощением абсолютного зла. Однако реальность оказалась куда прозаичнее: грозный повелитель тьмы на деле — не более чем ленивый босс-монстр, чья заветная мечта — предаваться безмятежному сну.

За этим сонным властелином неустанно следит Рене, горничная-гомункул, чья преданность хозяину граничит с одержимостью. Единственным оплотом здравомыслия в этом причудливом обществе остаётся Патрик — скелет, на чьих плечах держится всё функционирование подземелья.

Сможет ли великий и ужасный Сваллоу найти долгожданный покой среди этого невообразимого хаоса, или же судьба уготовила ему иной путь?

description.en:
Liliana Fence, is a kind-hearted and innocent daughter of an aristocrat. Being loved and spoiled, she never knew anything about hardships. Until one day she was charmed by Edward Carter, her new music teacher. When she thought her spring had finally arrived, turned out he actually despised her so much for being an aristocrat and an "innocent" one.

Since then, her world turned upside down. Her father suddenly committed suicide, leaving nothing but a massive debt. Forcefully living as a commoner, now Lily decided to never trust anyone anymore. But what would she do when Edward came back to her life while holding the very same feelings for her as she was for him back then?

I am in the world of a R19 novel based on a Little Red Riding Hood who preys on wolves. The problem is that my younger brother is a wolf. I hid us deep in the forest where Red Riding Hood wouldn't find us, and we're going to escape to the human world safely! But one day, I found a child collapsed in the snow and brought her home in order to treat her. But the girl happened to be the female lead: Little Red Riding Hood! "I don't remember anything." She lost her memories from the accident!

---
Eve was once a human woman who loved to read romance novels. But after being reincarnated as an ice magic-wielding wolf hybreed in one of her favorite stories, Eve runs into a dragon hybreed named Rahel who will kill her in the future and fall in love with her little brother, Sion. Now, Eve thinks her only hope of survival is to save enough money to move to the human world. But as Rahel grows more attached to her, Eve has no idea if she'll cool Rahel's fiery nature or burn in a blazing inferno!

description.fr:
C'est le monde du roman de 19 ans basé sur la princesse du Petit Chaperon Rouge qui mange un loup. Le problème, c'est que ce loup est mon petit frère. Je me suis cachée dans la forêt pour que le chaperon rouge ne nous trouve pas. Le but est de s'échapper vers le monde des humains en toute sécurité! Et puis, un jour. J'ai trouvé un enfant qui s'était effondré dans la forêt enneigée. On ne peut pas passer à côté d'un enfant malade. Je l'ai ramenée à la maison en pensant pouvoir la soigner.

C'était le personnage principal féminin, et elle a dit , «Je ne me souviens de rien.»

Pour aggraver les choses, elle a perdu la mémoire dans un accident!

«Je t'aime le mieux du monde!»

J'avais peur de la mort, mais je ne pouvais pas chasser froidement l'enfant malade, alors j'ai pris soin de lui. N'oublie pas ta gratitude même si tu as retrouvé la mémoire plus tard. Mais cet enfant…

«Quel est vôtre type idéal?»

«J'aime les hommes grands et larges d'épaules.»

«Un bel homme? Combien?»

Je pense que tu te poses beaucoup de questions sur moi. C'est mon erreur si vos yeux brillent quand je parle de mon type idéal, non?

description.en:
"I hate you enough to want to kill you, Sienna."

I was my sister’s shadow all my life, and I was betrayed by her and died. But… people have changed since the day I came back in time.

"You're the only child Nacht chose."

"His Highness recognizes you as family."

Something's wrong. These people seem to mistake me for my older sister.

"I beg you, believe in us for once, that we care for you."

I once wanted to be loved. Now I fear that this mindset will become my weakness. One betrayal was enough. Everything is over when you bet everything in love. I just want to get my life back so…

---
After being taken in by the noble house of Nacht, Sienna grew up with her adopted sister, Lorena, who she believed to be the sweetest, kindest person in the world. But after Lorena attempts to kill her, Sienna realizes how much her "loving" sister actually hated her. She tries to end her life with a magic potion but ends up going back in time instead. Determined to survive, she tries to use her memories to her advantage. For some strange reason though... Lorena is now nowhere to be found.
description.es: Te odio lo suficiente como para querer matarte, Sienna. Ella fue la sombra de su hermana toda su vida y fue traicionada por ella. Lo único que podía elegir era mi propia muerte. “Lo siento hermana, no podré conceder tu deseo de matarme”. Por cierto… Las personas de la mansión Natch que regresaron en el tiempo son diferentes a las de antes. “Eres la única niña que ha elegido el Gran duque”. “Su Alteza lo reconoce como miembro de su familia”. Algo está mal. Es como si estas personas me confundieran con mi hermana mayor. “Te lo estoy diciendo créeme solo una vez. Nosotros nos preocupamos por ti”. Una vez quise ser amado. Ahora tengo miedo de que ese corazón se convierta en una debilidad. Una traición fue suficiente para quitarme la vida. Se acabó el tiempo de apostar todo al amor. Sólo quiero recuperar mi vida. ‘Si no amo, ya no me lastimarán’. “Ahora es tiempo de ir por caminos separados”.
description.fr: Accueillie au sein de la froide maison Nacht, Sienna y fait la rencontre de Loreina et trouve en elle une sœur de fortune…Une sœur rassurante qui fait tourner son triste monde… Une sœur qui, pourtant, dans l’ombre, lui voue une haine tenace et tente un jour de l’assassiner. Encore sous le choc, Sienna fait un retour dans le passé et, à sa grande surprise, ne trouve aucune trace de la traîtresse… L'occasion unique de savoir à quoi ressemble une vie sans Loreina… Et si son absence était une délivrance?
description.id: "Aku membencimu sampai-sampai aku ingin membunuhmu, Sienna." Aku hidup di bawah bayangan kakak tiriku yang dicintai semua orang. Akhirnya aku memutuskan untuk mengakhiri hidupku sendiri setelah dikhianati kakakku. Tapi... aku malah kembali hidup di dunia ini, dan perlakuan orang-orang juga berubah. "Kamu adalah anak pilihan Nacht." "Yang mulia Grand Duke Nacht sudah menganggap anda seperti keluarga." Ada yang tidak beres. Sepertinya orang-orang mengira kalau aku adalah kakakku. Dulu aku memang ingin dicintai. Tapi aku takut keinginan ini menjadi kelemahanku. Cukup sekali saja aku dikhianati. Aku hanya ingin menjalani hidupku sendiri!

description.en:
Rexid van Hexen, prince of the Hexen Empire and feared defender of the border, wants to become emperor. But because his brain doesn't even come close to his brawn, he enlists the help of the "Viper," a notorious swindler and master of disguise. With her life on the line, the Viper must now pull off her greatest scam while posing as... Rexid's heiress? Will the unlikely duo succeed, or will they end up being deceived themselves?

---
A genius of disguise. A master of escape. One day, Grand Duke Hexen, the Tyrant of the Battlefield, came to see the genius swindler and death-row prisoner, 'Viper,' who stirred up the Empire.

"Hey, you need to help me."

"How can I help you?"

"I need to try becoming the emperor once in my life."

"...Huh?"

'...You?' The *Imperial Family's Disgrace*, *Crazy Northern Dog*, and *Tyrant of the Battlefield*. What can I do to help someone when even their brain is made of muscle?

"You must find a way for me to become the emperor. Or else you'll be put to death."

A chance given to her who wants to survive. A survival mission with an abysmal success rate! Make the black sheep of the imperial family into the emperor! We... You know that we have to work rather than have some romance, right?

"Can you hear it? My heart started beating like a crazy person's since you stuck to me like this. It's a side effect of the poison, right?"

"..."

"And when I see you, this crazy wrist keeps twitching. I think it wants to... touch you just like this..."

Rexid's hand which touched my back trembled. It felt like he was clenching his fists tightly, "I'm saying it just incase you misunderstood, but that doesn't mean I want to grope your body."

"Ah, yes."

description.fr:
Dans sa vie précédente, Viper était une arnaqueuse de génie utilisant son cerveau pour monter dans la hiérarchie et obtenir ce qu'elle voulait jusqu'à ce qu'elle se fasse prendre à son propre jeu et assassiner.

Viper, maintenant réincarnée dans le corps d'une orpheline a accepté sa mort et a décidé de ne plus vivre dans l'escroquerie. Elle se fait délibérément arrêter et enfermer au camp pour criminels de Drax. C'est la veille de son évasion, qu'elle reçoit dans sa cellule la visite de Rexid Van Hessen, le troisième prince de l'empire qui après avoir entendu les rumeurs selon lesquelles elle serait très intelligente décide de lui demander de l'aide afin qu'il devienne empereur.

Malgré que le nombre de candidats avant lui pouvant accéder au trône ne soit que de deux, la nature de Rexid à agir sans réfléchir et à être violent et agressif sans se préoccuper des lois l'envoie dans les terres du Nord pour combattre.

Si elle ne veut pas être exécutée et bénéficier d'une belle vie sans difficulté d'être soignée, nourrit ou logée, Viper doit accepter d'aider Rexid à devenir empereur, et puisqu'elle n'a rien pas le choix, la femme accepte même si pour elle cet homme qui malgré la possession d'un cerveau ne s'en sert pas ne pourra jamais gouverner l'empire.

description.de: Top-Schauspielerin Sia Lee lebt mit der verborgenen Fähigkeit, Geister zu sehen. Aber das ist noch nicht alles! Seit 20 Jahren hat sie einen mysteriösen, sich wiederholenden Traum vom Sterben - jedoch aus der Sicht einer fremden Frau. Eines Tages wacht sie nach einem Unfall am Set im Körper der Frau aus dem Traum auf: „Camilla Sorpel“, die verhasste Tochter des Herzogs! Sie ist fest entschlossen, ihrem vorbestimmten Tod zu entkommen. Kann sie mit ihrer Fähigkeit, Geister zu sehen, das Schicksal der Adligen ändern?
description.en:
Top actress Lee Sia has the ability to see ghosts. After an accident, she wakes up in the body of 'Camilla Sorfelle'.

But here's the problem.

"Oh, Father, help me!"

This woman's fate always ends in death!

I need to extend my life, so might as well talk to the ghosts first.

Ugh, but why do I keep getting involved with people I want to avoid?!

---
Actress Lee Sia hasn't just been haunted by ghosts for years, she's also been plagued by dreams of a girl named Camilla Sorphel dying repeatedly at the hands of her stepfather and stepbrother. Despite her efforts to ignore the dreams, when an accident at work makes her wake up as Camilla, she's forced to seek the help of various ghosts to win over her family and avoid getting killed. But can this former actress play the part of a loving daughter and sister to her future executors?
description.fr: L'actrice Lee Sia n'est pas seulement hantée par des fantômes depuis des années, elle est aussi tourmentée par des rêves récurrents dans lesquels une fille nommée Camilla Sorphel meurt encore et encore, tuée par son beau-père et son demi-frère. Malgré ses tentatives pour ignorer ces cauchemars, un accident sur son lieu de travail la fait se réveiller dans la peau de Camilla. Elle est alors contrainte de faire appel à divers fantômes pour gagner l'affection de sa nouvelle famille et éviter d’être tuée. Mais cette ancienne actrice peut-elle vraiment jouer le rôle d’une fille et d’une sœur aimante auprès de ceux qui sont censés devenir ses bourreaux?
description.id: Lee Sia adalah seorang aktris top yang memiliki kemampuan untuk melihat hantu. Setelah insiden yang menimpanya di lokasi shooting, dia terbangun ke dalam tubuh Camilla Sorphel, tokoh utama dalam mimpi buruk yang sudah dia mimpikan selama 20 tahun. Di dalam mimpinya, Camilla adalah seorang putri yang memiliki takdir untuk selalu mati di tangan keluarganya sendiri, tapi Sia tidak akan mati begitu saja. Prioritas utamanya untuk saat ini adalah untuk bertahan hidup dan akan bekerja sama dengan para hantu untuk mengubah takdirnya.

description.en:
“Die for us, just like you’ve served our family all along.”

Because of her crimson eyes and the dark splotch on her face, Arryl Brixia, the illegitimate child of the Brixia ducal house, had to live with a mask on her entire life. She tried desperately to win the acceptance of her family, but in the end, she met her death after being framed for treason.

But now, she’s returned to the past. She can no longer see the hideous splotch in her reflection in the mirror. But her face isn’t the only thing that’s changed from before — Ethan, the heir to the Burstein ducal family, suddenly comes and finds her…

“Lady Arryl, why do you wear a mask?”
“Why do you ask?”
“Your eyes.”
“What?”
“I saw your eyes. Your clear and confident eyes.”
“People fear them because they believe it’s the sign of the devil. Don’t you think so, Sir Ethan?”
“No, not at all. They look absolutely beautiful to me.”

The satisfying revenge story of Lady Arryl Brixia, who was abandoned by her own family.

description.en: As a child, Shin Woo-jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn’t like other children. He had an extraordinary gift—the ability to read people. By observing the smallest facial expressions and unconscious gestures, he could see through their thoughts, emotions, and intentions with near-perfect accuracy. Like a profiler, like a modern-day Sherlock, Woo-jin learned to navigate the world, one observation at a time. But for someone who sees too much, living an ordinary life is the hardest thing of all. All he ever wanted was a peaceful, simple life. But the world had other plans. “As I thought… living a normal life is far too difficult.”
description.pt-br: Após ser sequestrado na infância e viver como escravo por anos, Shin Woo-jin finalmente é resgatado e conhece o mundo exterior. Porém, ele possui uma habilidade extraordinária: a capacidade de ler pessoas, percebendo pensamentos, emoções e intenções através de pequenos gestos e expressões. Embora deseje apenas uma vida tranquila e comum, seu talento excepcional faz com que viver normalmente seja muito mais difícil do que imagina.

description.en:
I've possessed a character in an R-rated BL manhwa. It's in a world where people, whose craziness ranges from one to ten, appear.

"Franz, can you take off your clothes for a moment?"

"Sister? Wh-why my clothes?"

Their crazy serenade had already begun. Having been faced with the violence my younger brother had to endure, I made a vow.

"Instead of Franz, I'll have *Schuette* instead."

Those people are coming soon. The people who will exterminate my family, and when that's not enough, they'll devour my younger brother's innocence.

"And I'll become a knight to succeed our family and carry on its legacy."

If he doesn't go, I'll die! That's how I thoroughly hid my brother and decided attend all the official events myself. …But something's wrong.

"I do! I love Kyla Vesta!"

"If Young Miss gets hurt, then I'll…"

"I don't feel the need to wait any longer."

Didn't you all like men? Why are you all suddenly obsessed with me?

---
The fate of a girl in a BL novel is a tragic one. Girls are either vaguely helpful, evil, or add nothing to the plot. So what happens when you turn into the older sister of a BL novel protagonist? The older sister who dies a tragic death at the hands of a madman who’s infatuated with your younger brother? You go with your gut instinct: hide him. Hide your brother from everything, especially men, that could harm him and you. That’s the task that Kyla Vesta is set with in this life, and a task that she’s determined to complete.

When he next awoke, he was the young master of an immensely wealthy family. However, he wasn't just any noble son but Christian van Baren Kazar — the infamous, good-for-nothing bastard of the Magic Empire's Dark Magic Clan.

There were only two years left until Christian was fated to meet an untimely death. And even if he managed to survive that long, he still needed to stop the end of the world.

Chris had only one option if he wanted to survive and enjoy a life of wealth and luxury: seize control of the Dark Magic Clan and become a Demon King himself!

No entanto, ele não era um filho nobre qualquer, mas Christian van Baren Kazar — o infame e imprestável bastardo do Clã de Magia Negra do Império Mágico. Restavam apenas dois anos até que Christian estivesse fadado a encontrar uma morte prematura. E mesmo que conseguisse sobreviver tanto tempo, ainda precisava impedir o fim do mundo. description.en:
As if being reincarnated in the slums wasn't bad enough, I became the test subject of a cruel experiment in a crime-plagued city.  
  
One day, a man destroyed the research facility I was in, and upon recognizing him, I discovered I was in the world of a hopeless reverse harem novel.   
  
After I escaped from the research facility, I was living a normal life–until I moved in right next to the female lead’s house. I realized I’d become an extra from the novel, as well as the female lead’s neighbor!   
  
If everything goes according to plan, the female lead would save the villain, who fainted after being fatally injured, and would become the subject of his fanatical obsession.   
  
But why is the sub male lead villain here, unconscious in front of my house?   
  
Lakius Avalon was the king of the dark world, as well as the fearsome man I'd met at the research facility.  
  
I looked around quickly, then shoved his body with my foot.   
"You've come to the wrong house, villain."

I reincarnated as the villainess in a novel I had read, Jubellian Eloy Floyen. I was doomed to die, but no! With the memories of my previous life, I will avoid my death flag!  
  
“I will not marry a man who has no honor, no family, no property, and no power!”  
  
As I declared my will to live a glorious and glamorous life, my Dad decided to make the crown prince my fiancé?! Is he Mad?! I’ll just treat the engagement contract as a last measure.  
  
“Why are you avoiding your engagement with the Crown Prince?”  
  
“Because it scares me! He kills people who don’t obey him right away!”  
  
A few days later the Crown Prince sent me a letter. “Don’t worry, I won’t kill you.”  
  
Oh no… did I already do something worth dying for?

Джубеллиана Элой Флойен — злодейка из прочитанного мной романа, в который я попала. Она была обречена на смерть, но я нет! С воспоминаниями из моей прошлой жизни я избегу своего флага смерти!  
— Я не выйду замуж за человека, у которого нет чести, семьи, нет собственности и даже власти!  
Когда я заявила о своем желании жить славной и гламурной жизнью, мой папа решил сделать наследного принца моим женихом?! Он сошёл с ума?! Я просто отнесусь к договору о помолвке как к крайней мере.  
— Почему ты избегаешь помолвки с кронпринцем?  
— Потому что я боюсь! Он сразу же убивает людей, которые не подчиняются ему!  
Через несколько дней наследный принц прислал мне письмо: «Не волнуйся, я не убью тебя».  
О, нет… Я уже сделала то, из-за чего меня могут убить?

description.en:
I became the wife of a man who already had a lover.  
So, I should do my best to help him remain faithful to her, right?  
  
But how did I end up destroying the bed with him on our first night together…?  
  
***  
  
Aristine is a royal princess who's been confined all her life, as she is highly disfavored by the emperor.  
But the truth is, as the possessor of the [Royal Sight], she can see the past, present, and future.  
  
The emperor sends her off to die in a political marriage arranged with the prince of their enemy country, rumored to be a bloodthirsty savage, but…  
Her soon-to-be husband, the so-called "savage," is far more normal than the rumors suggest.  
  
"Still, he's taken, so he's off-limits for me. I'll just focus on making lots of money from now on!"  
  
Will Aristine be able to fulfill her dream of living a luxurious, wealthy life?  
Or will she be able to kill two birds with one stone and win over her husband as well?
description.ru:
Оказалось, что у моего мужа есть другая женщина.
Должна ли я потребовать исполнения супружеского долга?

"И потом... Вы можете спать на полу"
"Чего?"
Ах да, пол же слишком жесткий. Как жаль, что не могу тебе ничем помочь.
"Я буду просто держать Вашу руку и спать. Вы ведь доверяете мне, не так ли?

И все же, как, черт возьми, они умудрились сломать кровать?!

Принцесса Аристина, прозванная «Бдительным глазом» - обладательница «Королевского взора», способности, дающей возможность видеть прошлое, настоящее и будущее.
Став жертвой политических интриг, она была насильно отправлена к ужасным варварам…

«Я подарю тебе множество драгоценностей, моя невеста»

Слухи о том, что мой будущий муж – монстр, преувеличены.

Но этот рисовый пирог, это чей-то ещё рисовый пирог.
Поэтому я уйду и начну зарабатывать.

Буду жить в золоте и роскоши!

Я буду сама себя обеспечивать!

Сможет ли Аристина сделать это? Сможет ли она исполнить свою мечту «жить свободно и купаться в роскоши»? Или, может, она «убьет двух зайцев одним выстрелом»?

description.en:
"Don't look down on me just because I'm a child! Even though I look like this, this is my 10th life!"

I'm an illegitimate princess whose life was cut short after being misunderstood for having the same blood as the enemy country and died early. After nine tragic repetitions, I discovered the identity of my biological father. He is Paeon, a war hero who defeated the demon king and the strongest holy knight in the continent. He had a forbidden relationship with the princess, had me, and then deserted me!

In order to survive the harsh royal palace, I've decided to use and then abandon this impudent father. I will become the strongest as fast as I can and escape from this disgusting country!

And so, while I was building my strength, I happened to meet the demon king's son, Leo. He wasn't arrogant like his father, but he was pitifully living in captivity. So, I took care of him in secret.

"Asha, you cannot get engaged to anyone."

"...Huh? Why?"

"Because I’ll take responsibility for you forever."

"What?!"

"We spent the night together."

...What is this prince saying?

A holy knight father who had (?) a forbidden love. Along with an enemy prince who is trying (!) to have a forbidden love. With them, can the unfortunate princess change her fate?

---
As an illegitimate princess, Anastasia Entimos has died in just about every way imaginable. Every time she dies, she is brought back to the moment of her birth and forced to relive her tragic fate. It is only in her 10th life that she discovers her father is the esteemed knight and war hero, Paeon Parschel! Determined to escape her miserable fate once and for all, Anastasia vows to use her aloof father as a stepping stone to freedom. Will the 10th time be the charm for this ill-fated princess?

“Sırf bir çocuk olduğum için beni küçümseme! Bu benim onuncu yaşamım!” O, düşman ülkenin kanına sahip olduğu sanılan ve erkenden öldürülen gayrimeşru bir prenses. 9 trajik döngüden sonra, babasının kim olduğunu bulur. Varisin, sağlığını sürekli takip eden bakıcın ya da seni yavru köpekler gibi takip eden şövalyeler gibi olacağımı düşünme! En güçlü kişi olacağım ve bu iğrenç ülkeden mümkün olduğunca çabuk kaçacağım! Leo, iblisin oğlu, onunla büyürken tanıştım. Babamı anlayamıyor değildim ama hapishanede bir rehine olarak yaşamak biraz acınasıydı. “Ne? Neden? Tüm hayatım boyunca senin için sorumluluk alacağım.” “Ne?” “Gece birlikteydik.” Prens ne diyor..? description.ko:
무공에 미친 사내 광마 이자하.
그가 미치기 전의 평범했던 시절로 돌아왔다.

세상에 광마로 알려진 이자하.
그는 마교 교주의 보물인 천옥을, 주인인 교주가 마음에 들지 않는다는 이유로 훔친다.
이어지는 마교의 추적.
이자하는 몇 날 며칠 쫓아오는 수많은 마교 정예들을 처단했지만 결국 막다른 길에 몰려 더는 도주할 수 없게 되고,
추적자들과 교주에게 엿을 먹이기 위해 죽기 전에 천옥을 집어삼키고 장렬하게 마지막 싸움을 치른 뒤 벼랑에 떨어지게 되는데,

눈을 떠보니 모두에게 무시당하던 자하객잔의 점소이 시절로 돌아와 있다.
과거로 돌아온 그의 머릿속엔 이 상황에 대한 의문점보다는 다른 생각이 들어찬다.
‘더 강해질 수 있다!’
한 번 걸어간 길이고 무공에 대한 이해가 높으니 광마 시절보다 더 강해질 수 있다는 사실뿐.
주변 상황 파악보다는 자신의 몸 상태를 살피고 내공 심법부터 돌리는 이자하.
그걸 마친 후에나 상황을 살펴보니 자신이 최근 말도 안 되는 누명으로 두들겨 맞고 객잔은 박살 나 있던 때라는 걸 알게 된다.
과거 모두에게 무시당하며 살던 평범한 점소이가 아닌 무림을 오시하던 광마 이자하로 뒤바뀐 상황.
그는 어떤 행보를 이어갈 것인가!

Seingatku terakhir kali aku tertangkap oleh pasukan musuh saat berusaha melarikan diri.
Padahal aku tidak memiliki ingatan mati, tapi aneh sekali tiba-tiba aku terbangun menjadi seekor elang di markas militer negaraku sendiri. Bagaimana nasib saudara-saudaraku yang sama-sama lari menyelamatkan diri dari serangan musuh?
Satu-satunya cara agar aku bisa mendapatkan informasi adalah dengan tetap berada di dekat Rumares Balhail, panglima kejam ini. description.en:
As the only hope to stop the end of the world, I’ve lived 99 lives with everyone pressuring me to sacrifice myself. I dearly hoped this life would be my last…!

“A lady is born!”

I’ve ended up beginning my 100th life. They’re going to give me a hero treatment and sacrifice me again anyways. Is what I thought, but—

“Thank you for being born safely.”
“Unnie’s gon to get dem all for you!”
“Can I please see our youngest smiling as well?”
“Hey little baby, did you miss me?”

This life is a bit… weird.
